structured_output.what_is_happening: 和平熊猫 ("Peace Panda", $熊猫) is riding news from today, 2026-09-24. At the Trump–Xi summit, Xi announced that China will send the giant pandas Ping Ping ("peace peace") and Fu Shuang to Zoo Atlanta as "envoys of friendship". Many copycat 熊猫 tokens launched within the hour. This one was not launched on the pump.fun curve. The mint (address not ending in 'pump') was created about 16:10 UTC and its PumpSwap pool was seeded directly, holding about $240k in liquidity against a $220k market cap. Trading is frenzied: about $4.9M volume in 40 minutes and +170%. But GeckoTerminal counts 1,662 unique buyers against only 61 unique sellers, and 0% of the LP is locked or burned.
